movements.spokenClaim: Hephaestus at the bronze anvil with twenty bellows and Thetis
movements.sightBanner: Iliad 18.478–482 · §I The Crucible & The Fivefold Metallic Foundation
movements.activeSubtitle: First, beneath twenty roaring bellows, Hephaestus forged a shield both great and strong, adorning it all over.

movements.spokenClaim: Earth, Sky, Sea, untiring Sun, full Moon, and revolving Bear
movements.sightBanner: Iliad 18.483–489 · §II The Central Cosmic Boss & The Unbathing Bear
movements.activeSubtitle: And the Pleiades, the Hyades, mighty Orion, and the Great Bear, who revolves in her place and alone never bathes in Ocean.

movements.spokenClaim: Brides led beneath blazing torches with whirling dancers and doorway women
movements.sightBanner: Iliad 18.490–496 · §III City at Peace I: The Torchlit Bridal Procession
movements.activeSubtitle: Beneath blazing pine torches they led brides from their chambers as young men whirled to flutes and lyres, and women marveled at their portals.

movements.spokenClaim: Sacred circle of polished stones, elders with staves, two litigants & Two Talents of Gold
movements.sightBanner: Iliad 18.497–508 · §IV City at Peace II: The Sacred Circle & Two Talents of Gold
movements.activeSubtitle: Therefore the elders sat on polished stones in a sacred circle, rising in turn with heralds' staves around two talents of gold for the straightest judgment.

movements.spokenClaim: Besieged city wall, 1.6x golden Ares & Athena, two piping herdsmen & river ambush
movements.sightBanner: Iliad 18.509–540 · §V City at War: Siege Walls, Tall Golden Gods & River Ambush
movements.activeSubtitle: Crouched by the river watering-place, they sprang upon two piping shepherds and their flocks, while Strife, Tumult, and crimson Fate dragged the fallen through the ford.

movements.spokenClaim: Thrice-ploughed golden field darkening behind yoked oxen & headland wine-cup
movements.sightBanner: Iliad 18.541–549 · §VI The Thrice-Ploughed Golden Glebe Darkening Behind the Share
movements.activeSubtitle: And the earth grew black behind the ploughshare like newly turned soil, though wrought of pure gold: a supreme marvel of the forge.

movements.spokenClaim: Reapers with sickles, sheaf-binders, oak feast & Silent King holding his sceptre
movements.sightBanner: Iliad 18.550–560 · §VII The Silent Rejoicing King’s Harvest & Oak Sacrifice
movements.activeSubtitle: Among them the King stood in silence with his scepter along the swath, rejoicing in his heart, while beneath an oak heralds prepared the feast.

movements.spokenClaim: Golden vines, black grapes, silver poles, kyanos trench & boy playing the lyre
movements.sightBanner: Iliad 18.561–572 · §VIII The Five-Metal Vineyard & The Boy’s Linus Song
movements.activeSubtitle: In their midst a boy played sweetly on a clear-toned lyre and sang the delicate Linus song in a slender voice as youths beat the earth in time.

movements.spokenClaim: Cattle of gold and tin by the river, 4 golden herdsmen, 9 dogs & 2 lions seizing the bull
movements.sightBanner: Iliad 18.573–586 · §IX Oxen of Gold and Tin, Two Terrible Lions & Nine Barking Hounds
movements.activeSubtitle: Four golden herdsmen urged on their nine swift hounds; yet as the lions lapped the dark blood, the dogs stood close, barking and darting back.

movements.spokenClaim: Dancing-floor of Daedalus in Knossos spinning like a potter’s wheel around 2 tumblers
movements.sightBanner: Iliad 18.587–606 · §X The Mountain Sheep Glen & Daedalus’s Choros of Knossos
movements.activeSubtitle: Youths with golden daggers and garlanded maidens spun as swiftly as a seated potter trials his wheel between his palms, while two tumblers whirled in the midst.

movements.spokenClaim: Complete 7,538-brick circular Shield sealed at the uttermost rim by River Oceanus
movements.sightBanner: Iliad 18.607–608 · §XI The Uttermost Rim of River Oceanus Sealing the Cosmos
movements.activeSubtitle: The bellows fell silent: a complete, breathing cosmos of seven thousand five hundred and thirty-eight bricks, sealed inside the armor of Achilles.
